value.text:
Round DZ review of pm-rust#181 at 516d391 against pm-cli 2026.11.18. All 15 findings apply.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2tN — native_note_repair_replays_only_in_the_selected_tracker and linked_note_recovery_matches_published_semantics. The oracle accepts a separate hyphen-leading note, and the native retry retains that grammar and the following flags.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2tU — sdk_collection_reads_ignore_the_artifact_base. SDK listing and linked-test operations ignore unused directories, including an empty path.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2tX — collection_restore_after_removal_is_read_only and cli_omitted_rows_retain_tracker_root_as_invocation_directory. SDK restores use the selected absolute tracker and replay from another tracker with the same ID. CLI relative and non-UTF-8 guidance are verified separately.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2ta — private_sdk_principals_refuse_before_storage. Explicit and scoped invalid principals refuse before forced pause can modify item, history or session bytes. The published CLI rejects the corresponding invalid author before mutation.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2tn — claim_eligibility_handles_the_utc_year_boundary. The pinned oracle reports +010000-01-01T00:30:00.000Z across the boundary. Native gives null outside its UTC range and matches the in-range value.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2tx — ownership_session_faults_and_contention_preserve_durable_steps. Both implementations save the release on lock contention. The oracle says nothing needs a retry. Native now directs callers to check and reconcile only session attribution after the lock clears.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2t1 — stale_session_lock_lifecycle_matches_published_bytes. Owned and unowned pause, claim, release and start each assert stale lock removal in both trackers.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2t6 — reclaimed_session_writer_cannot_replace_new_attribution. A disconnected channel aborts publication and leaves the session unchanged. Successor publication still fences the old writer.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2uB — session_publication_waits_for_transient_cleanup_gate. The publisher releases the fixture gate only after observing actual contention. The next acquisition publishes the snapshot.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65kcQN — artifact_cwd_file_refusal_preserves_item_and_history and artifact_cwd_resolves_root_alias_without_following_its_suffix. A regular file in the base or its ancestry refuses before any write, and a missing directory still anchors the link. The flag is native-only.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65kcQU — project_alias_removal_preserves_internal_directory_symlinks. Project-root alias and direct logical removal select the same stored path. An alias directly into a project subdirectory also remains usable.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65kcQb — projected_collection_recovery_keeps_the_selected_binary and encoded_identity_projection_preserves_native_recovery. Redaction covers copies of encoded identity credentials while retaining public message text. The published CLI also protects the copied fixture.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65kcQj — session_acquisition_refreshes_the_clock_on_retry. Deterministic samples prove an initially live lease expires within the wait and the new receipt uses the successful attempt's clock, matching the oracle's per-attempt policy.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65kcQp — recency_honors_event_classes_and_legacy_paths plus the orientation differential. Established event classes take precedence, and the fallback uses borrowed paths with the existing maintenance and malformed-path behavior.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65kcQ2 — projected_collection_recovery_keeps_the_selected_binary and encoded_identity_projection_preserves_native_recovery. Projected recovery retains pm-rust for its native-only flag and pm for published arguments.
